newsitem.title: UK: Wall St, telecoms buoy UK's FTSE before key data.
newsitem.headline: Wall St, telecoms buoy UK's FTSE before key data.

text.p: The British stock market opened modestly higher on Wednesday, buoyed by Wall Street's return to record-breaking form, favourable company data and strong gains among telecommunications stocks, traders said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares was up 6.8 points at 3,984.9 some 10 minutes after the start of official trade, but off earlier highs set on Wall Street's surprise 0.8 percent gain overnight.

"Wall Street was nice, of course, but the market is in a bit of a quandary with the (British) political situation, next week's budget, rates and inflation worries, and retail sales this morning. So it's looking a bit wobbly," one dealer said.
